description: Two independent sections that each turn a trigger into a gate of a length you set

params.text: Sets how long this section's gate lasts, 0 to 1 second; at the fully counter-clockwise setting the gate opens and never closes, because the timer is measured against a length of zero it cannot pass

inputs.text: Opens this section's gate on each rising edge above 0V; an edge arriving while the gate is already open does not restart it

outputs.text: Carries 10V for the length set by this section's gate knob after each trigger, and 0V the rest of the time

notes: neither output is given a name in the code, so hovering either one shows no tooltip at all
the two sections share nothing: each has its own trigger, its own length knob and its own gate, and neither affects the other

inputs.0:
high above 0V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 0V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
